end

function main()
    out = Dict{String,Any}()
    if !CUDA.functional()
        println(JSON3.write(Dict("error" => "CUDA not functional"))); exit(1)
    end
    check_transformer_fused(out)
    out["device"] = CUDA.name(CUDA.device())
    println(JSON3.write(out))
end
main()
